note: Both sets capture the same core facts (filter type, 0.0125 s time step, 0.25 Hz corner frequency) and both contain the same two unsupported readings: a phase of -80 deg at 1.00 Hz whose quote says -75, and a magnitude of -12.5 dB at 1.00 Hz whose quote says -12. Set A adds a third unsupported value, phase -72 deg at 1.00 Hz, which contradicts the -75 deg shown in the plot and its own quote, and it also duplicates several readings with only the figure caption as support. Set B binds the -75 deg phase and -12 dB magnitude to quotes that actually contain those numbers, so it is the cleaner, more faithful set.
